name: ASM-014 bicycle pedal-crank assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a bicycle bottom bracket, crank arm, chainring spider, pedal, bearings, and repeated fasteners.

tasks.prompt: Create a recognizable bicycle pedal-crank subassembly with bottom bracket shell, crank arms, chainring spider, pedal platform, axle, bearing caps, and repeated chainring bolts. Use simple robust primitives.
assumptions: Intermediate assembly benchmark extends transport/mechanical coverage with robust primitive geometry.
Repeated occurrences represent functional hardware such as bolts, bearing caps, and reflectors rather than tiny decorative details.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD benchmark pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
